text: Implemented axis-aligned anisotropic Gaussian end-to-end: Smoother.anisotropic, KernelBandwidth, per-axis resolution/support errors, complete cards/configuration/provenance, StudyEstimate.Anisotropic, recipe descriptors, study and temporal execution, plan/result wire encodings and diagnostic coverage, and contrast CSV /2 axis columns. PRD/architecture and executable user guide revised with scope and migration notes; generated diagnostic table reviewed (exactly two added cases). Numerical evidence: direct 2-D source-deposition oracle on rectangular cells, edge mass policy, transpose, weighted linearity, normalization, exact isotropic equality at equal supported widths, static mixed-unit rejection, invalid axis/support checks. Intentional y-bandwidth mutant killed by four tests and source restored. Verification completed across all 24 JVM/JS module test groups: 3080 pre-IO tests passed in /private/tmp/eyes4s-anisotropic-verified.log; after correcting a new temporal test that incorrectly used reference equality, both entire IO suites passed 489 tests in /private/tmp/eyes4s-anisotropic-io-docs-final.log (3569 total). checkBoundaries, headerCheckAll, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, githubWorkflowCheck, docs/mdoc (11 files, zero errors), tools/check-docs.py and git diff --check passed. Scoped source changes remain uncommitted, preserving the earlier CSV rendering work and unrelated .claude/. No publication or external consumer republishing performed. eyesim-kde conformance remains a separate open scope.
